answer: Each answer commits to a run identifier that must be unique within the epoch, so 161 answers need 161 separate inference runs with separate seeds. Because the vertex index holds every id for the epoch, the collision is provable from the ledger, and the dune audit republishes the full set. Reusing one run across aliases collides on the zenith identifier and voids the later submissions, which means the operator forfeits for 161 runs and collects one. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
